name: FrenchModelVariant562_DrawShards
evidence: matching french_model_variant/variant562_shards.c: places each 0x74-byte shard along the heading from ratan2, projects both halves with RotTransPers3 and sorts them as POLY_GT4 with GsSortPoly in two passes; the header-405 entry calls it in its frame update (notes/overlays/french-model-variant562-shards.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the PAL and Japanese header-405 images and the US header-388 images build the same source; the US and Japanese images bind it 4 bytes higher. Bound at 0x8013C2CC/0x8017C2CC in the PAL images. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
